aiThesis.rationale: The structural economics of BITF's business model are fundamentally flawed. A company cannot sustainably burn $1.50 in free cash flow for every $1.00 of revenue it generates (-$347M FCF on $229M Revenue). The infrastructure race (whether for crypto mining or AI pivot) is purely an arms race of capital expenditure. Without a differentiated moat, BITF will be forced to repeatedly dilute shareholders (currently 602M shares, heavily expanded over recent years) to fund operations. The 'Bull' case ($4.88) assumes a miraculous pivot to highly profitable hosting, but the 'Base' case ($0.43) reflects the grim reality of commodity computing.
